summary: PulseGuard v0.6.27 fixes the Windows-integrity repair gate exposed by a real i9/RTX 3070 test system, improves PCIe WHEA diagnostics, hardens WinGet automation/reboot reporting, protects Windows system-profile PATH entries, and preserves exact driver-update evidence.

sections.heading: SFC corruption now forces the real repair path
sections.detail: FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL now treats the completed Full Health Scan as authoritative. If the baseline proves SFC corruption, a healthy DISM /CheckHealth result can no longer skip repair. PulseGuard runs DISM /RestoreHealth, then SFC /scannow, then a deep DISM/SFC verification pass before deciding whether Windows integrity is fixed.

sections.heading: PCIe WHEA Event 17 diagnostics are more specific
sections.detail: WHEA parsing now reads both Component and Reported by component formats plus Primary/Secondary Bus:Device:Function and PCI device names. PulseGuard resolves the reported PCI hardware ID against its driver inventory and records the matching root-port device and any direct present downstream PnP devices it can safely identify.

sections.heading: Resolved WHEA history stays historical
sections.detail: Event-backed INFO findings such as corrected WHEA Event 17 records now honor the same verified-fix watermark logic as higher-severity event findings. Old corrected-error records remain available for diagnostics but are shown as monitoring/history after a relevant verified repair or driver update unless a newer matching event occurs.

sections.heading: WinGet is fully unattended and restart-aware
sections.detail: The visible elevated application-update stage now runs winget upgrade --all with --accept-source-agreements and --accept-package-agreements so a first-use Microsoft Store source prompt cannot stall FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL. Output is still shown live, captured to the report/log, and left visible for five seconds after completion.

sections.heading: WinGet path quoting and restart reporting fixed
sections.detail: PulseGuard now launches WinGet through a temporary quoted CMD helper so install locations containing spaces, including OneDrive/Desktop paths, preserve the full log/result arguments. Installer output is scanned for restart-required messages and the report, optimization verification, and final status explicitly surface when Windows should be restarted.

sections.heading: Windows system-profile PATH entries are review-only
sections.detail: A temporarily missing Windows system-profile directory is no longer classified as an automatic SAFE-FIX simply because the folder does not exist during one scan. Those protected machine PATH entries are retained as REVIEW evidence instead of PulseGuard trying to rewrite HKLM PATH.

sections.heading: Deep Clean summary now matches its detailed result
sections.detail: The FIX + OPTIMIZE workflow summary now reports Deleted, Freed, Safely skipped/in-use, and Actual errors as separate values. Locked active cache files remain harmless skips and no longer disappear into a misleading skipped/errors count.

sections.heading: Exact driver-update audit is retained
sections.detail: The consolidated report now includes a DriverUpdateAction block that survives the automatic post-fix rescan and records the driver-update engine version, update count, restart requirement, source, package/device name, device ID where available, and before/candidate/after versions for verified installs.
